==English==
{{wp|Medes}}
{{swp|+#Places}}

===Etymology===
{{bor+|en|la|Mēdia}}, from {{der|en|grc|Μηδία}}, from {{m|grc|Μῆδος}}, from {{m|xme-old||*Mada}} (vocalization uncertain), the {{der|en|xme-old|-}} language self-designator signifying speakers of the Median language. Compare {{cog|peo|𐎶𐎠𐎭|tr=Māda}}. Ultimately from {{der|en|ine-pro|*médʰyos||middle}} i.e. central kingdom, cognate with {{cog|sa|sc=Deva|मध्य|tr=mádhya}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈmiːdɪə/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-media.wav|a=Southern England}}
